Hassan_Zirak.title: Hassan Zirak
Hassan_Zirak.extract: Hassan Zirek was a Kurdish singer-songwriter, known for his recordings of Kurdish folk and classical songs. He was famous for his classical and sensual lyrics, and it is believed that he composed over a thousand songs in his lifetime.

Mohammad_Mamle.title: Mohammad Mamle
Mohammad_Mamle.extract: Muhammad Mamle was a Kurdish musician and singer. He sang, wrote and renewed many Kurdish folkloric songs. He is regarded as an influential and important figure among the Kurds and others.

Şivan_Perwer.title: Şivan Perwer
Şivan_Perwer.extract: Şivan Perwer is a Kurdish poet, writer, music teacher, and singer. Perwer fled Turkey in 1976 due to bans and restrictions imposed on Kurdish music. He lived in continuous exile for 37 years, returning to Diyarbakır on 16 November 2013 upon an invitation by the prime minister of Turkey at the time,

Ciwan_Haco.title: Ciwan Haco
Ciwan_Haco.extract: Ciwan Haco is a Syrian Kurdish singer. He was born in Tirbespî near Qamishli in northern Syria. His grandfather was originally from Doğançay in Turkey. After finishing high school, he left for Germany in order to continue his studies. He studied musicology at the Ruhr University Bochum. He is now re

Aram_Tigran.title: Aram Tigran
Aram_Tigran.extract: Aram Tigran or Aramê Dîkran, born Aram Melikyan, was a contemporary Syrian-Armenian singer who sang primarily in Kurdish. Among Assyrians in Qamishli, he was known as Aram Dikran.

Ahmet_Kaya.title: Ahmet Kaya
Ahmet_Kaya.extract: Ahmet Kaya was a Turkish–Kurdish folk singer. Kaya was persecuted by Turkish nationalist celebrities and authorities. Kaya left Turkey in an act of self-exile, and moved to France, where he would shortly after die of a heart attack.

Ayşe_Şan.title: Ayşe Şan
Ayşe_Şan.extract: Ayşe Şan was a Kurdish singer. She was also known by the names Eyşana Kurd, Eyşe Xan, Eyşana Eli. She is considered one of the most legendary voices in contemporary Kurdish music.

Tahsin_Taha.title: Tahsin Taha
Tahsin_Taha.extract: Tahsin Muhammed Salim Taha. was a Kurdish singer. Taha was born in Amadiya District in Iraqi Kurdistan. Tahsin Taha finished his school in the city of Amadiya and moved to Baghdad for higher education. Taha graduated from the Institute of Fine Arts in Baghdad in 1964. Taha registered his first song

Mazhar_Khaleqi.title: Mazhar Khaleqi
Mazhar_Khaleqi.extract: Mazhar Khaleghi is an Iranian Kurdish, famous for his folklore Kurdish music. He currently resides in the United Kingdom.

Adnan_Karim.title: Adnan Karim
Adnan_Karim.extract: Adnan Karim is a prominent Kurdish singer, known for his song adaptations of classical Kurdish poems. He is also a painter.

Mihemed_Şêxo.title: Mihemed Şêxo
Mihemed_Şêxo.extract: Mihemed Şêxmûs Salih better known as Mihemed Şêxo, was one of the most important Kurdish folk singers. With his sentimental, traditional and often political lyrics he created great Kurdish music like few before him. His work is still well-known and listened to today.

Zakaria_Abdulla.title: Zakaria Abdulla
Zakaria_Abdulla.extract: Zakaria Abdulla is a Kurdish musician. He is best known for his pop music, which combines Kurdish melodies with popular regional music styles.

Aziz_Waisi.title: Aziz Waisi
Aziz_Waisi.extract: Aziz Waisi. Is a popular Kurdish singer.

Sherko_Bekas.title: Sherko Bekas
Sherko_Bekas.extract: Sherko Fayaq Abdullah, was a Kurdish poet. He was born on 2 May 1940 in Sulaymaniyah, Kurdistan Region in Iraq as the son of the poet Faiq Bekas. He is widely regarded as one of the poets who founded contemporary Kurdish poetry. Sherko's poetry explores liberty, love, life, and nature while reflecti

Cigerxwîn.title: Cigerxwîn
Cigerxwîn.extract: Cigerxwîn or Cegerxwîn was a Kurdish writer and poet. He is considered one of the most influential figures in Kurdish literature. Many of his poems were later adapted into songs, and his work played an important role in the preservation and development of Kurdish culture and literary heritage.

Ehmedê_Xanî.title: Ehmedê Xanî
Ehmedê_Xanî.extract: Ehmedê Xanî, also Ahmad-e Khani) was a Kurdish intellectual, scholar, mystic and poet who is viewed by some as the founder of Kurdish nationalism. He was born in the Hakkâri region in 1650 and died in Bayazid in 1707.

Ahmad_Khani.title: Ehmedê Xanî
Ahmad_Khani.extract: Ehmedê Xanî, also Ahmad-e Khani) was a Kurdish intellectual, scholar, mystic and poet who is viewed by some as the founder of Kurdish nationalism. He was born in the Hakkâri region in 1650 and died in Bayazid in 1707.

Piremerd.title: Piramerd
Piremerd.extract: Tawfeq Mahmoud Hamza known as Piramerd was a Kurdish poet, writer, novelist and journalist. He was born in the Goija neighborhood of Sulaymaniyah, Kurdistan Region. In 1926, he became the editor of the Kurdish newspaper Jîyan. He also established a private Kurdish school in Kurdistan, called Pertûkx

Abdulla_Goran.title: Abdullah Goran
Abdulla_Goran.extract: Abdullah Goran was a leading Kurdish poet and translator of the 20th century.

Faqi_Tayran.title: Feqiyê Teyran
Faqi_Tayran.extract: Feqiyê Teyran was a Kurdish poet who wrote in Kurmanji. He is best known for his work Zembîlfiroş, and is also credited for writing the first literary account of the Battle of Dimdim which took place in 1609 and 1610. He is considered a pioneer in Kurdish Sufi literature and one of the founders of t

Melayê_Cizîrî.title: Melayê Cizîrî
Melayê_Cizîrî.extract: Ahmad Nîşanî, better known as Melayê Cizîrî, was a Kurdish poet, theologian, and Sufi mystic. He was born c. 1570 in Cizre and died c. 1640 in Diyarbakır.

Mawlawi_Tawagozi.title: Mawlawi Tawagozi
Mawlawi_Tawagozi.extract: Mawlawi Tawagozi, pen name Maʿdumi, better known as Mawlawi was a Kurdish poet and leading Kurdish literary figure in the 19th century. He wrote in Gorani, Arabic and Persian.

Abdulla_Pashew.title: Abdulla Pashew
Abdulla_Pashew.extract: Abdulla Pashew is a Kurdish poet. He was born in 1946 in Hewlêr, southern Kurdistan. He studied at the Teachers' Training Institute in Hewlêr (Erbil), and participated in the Foundation Congress of the Kurdish Writers' Union in Baghdad in 1970. In 1973 he went to the former Soviet Union, and in 1979

Latif_Halmat.title: Latif Halmat
Latif_Halmat.extract: Latif Halmat is a Kurdish poet. He was born in town of Kifri, Iraq and began writing poems in 1963. He worked as a journalist during the 1970s and 1980s. He has published 20 poetry books in Kurdish and many of his works have been translated into other languages. He has also been active in the area o

Refiq_Sabir.title: Rafiq Sabir
Refiq_Sabir.extract: Rafiq Sabir (1950-2026) is a contemporary Kurdish poet.

Masoud_Barzani.title: Masoud Barzani
Masoud_Barzani.extract: Masoud Barzani is a Kurdish politician who has been leader of the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) since 1979, and was President of the Kurdistan Region of Iraq from 2005 to 2017.

Mustafa_Barzani.title: Mustafa Barzani
Mustafa_Barzani.extract: Mustafa Barzani, also known as Mullah Mustafa, was a Kurdish nationalist leader and one of the most prominent political figures in modern Kurdish politics.

Jalal_Talabani.title: Jalal Talabani
Jalal_Talabani.extract: Jalal Talabani was an Iraqi Kurdish politician who served as the 6th president of Iraq from 2005 to 2014, as well as the president of the Governing Council of Iraq.

Qazi_Muhammad.title: Qazi Muhammad
Qazi_Muhammad.extract: Qazi Muhammad was an Iranian Kurdish Islamic cleric and political leader who founded the Democratic Party of Iranian Kurdistan (PDKI) and was the first president of the short-lived, Soviet-backed, though internationally unrecognized, secessionist Republic of Mahabad. He was hanged by the Iranian gov

Abdul_Rahman_Ghassemlou.title: Abdul Rahman Ghassemlou
Abdul_Rahman_Ghassemlou.extract: Abdul Rahman Ghassemlou was an Iranian Kurdish politician and leader. Ghassemlou was the Secretary-General of the Democratic Party of Iranian Kurdistan (KDPI) from 1971 until his assassination in 1989 by individuals suspected of being agents of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

Nechirvan_Barzani.title: Nechirvan Barzani
Nechirvan_Barzani.extract: Nechirvan Idris Barzani is an Iraqi Kurdish politician serving as the second President of the Kurdistan Region. He was elected into office by the Kurdistan Region Parliament in June 2019. Nechirvan Barzani was appointed as Vice President of the Kurdistan Democratic Party since 2010. He previously se

Sheikh_Ubeydullah.title: Sheikh Ubeydullah
Sheikh_Ubeydullah.extract: Sheikh Ubeydullah (1826–1883), also known as Sayyid Ubeydullah, was the leader of the first modern Kurdish nationalist struggle. Ubeydullah demanded recognition from the Ottoman Empire and Qajar Iran authorities for an independent Kurdish state, or Kurdistan, which he would govern without interferen

Sheikh_Said.title: Sheikh Said
Sheikh_Said.extract: Sheikh Said was a Zaza Kurd religious leader, one of the leading sheikhs of the Naqshbandi order and the head of the Sheikh Said rebellion.

Sadegh_Sharafkandi.title: Sadegh Sharafkandi
Sadegh_Sharafkandi.extract: Sadegh Sharafkandi was a Kurdish political activist and the Secretary-General of the Kurdistan Democratic Party of Iran (PDKI). He was killed in the Mykonos restaurant assassinations in Berlin in September 1992.

Idris_Barzani.title: Idris Barzani
Idris_Barzani.extract: Idris Barzani was a Kurdish politician in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. Born in the village of Barzan in 1944, his early life was shaped by the political upheavals of the Kurdish movement and the exile of his family following periods of conflict with the Iraqi government.

Ibrahim_Ahmad.title: Ibrahim Ahmad
Ibrahim_Ahmad.extract: Ibrahim Ahmad was an Iraqi Kurdish writer, novelist, jurist and translator who founded the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan in 1975. He is the father-in-law of former President Jalal Talabani and current President Abdul Latif Rashid through both of his daughters, Hero Ibrahim Ahmed and Shanaz Ibrahim Ah

Salahaddin_Bahaaddin.title: Salahaddin Bahaaddin
Salahaddin_Bahaaddin.extract: Salahaddin Mohammed Bahaaddin Sadiq is a Kurdish Iraqi politician. He is a graduate of The House of Teachers 1969. He is the co-founder and current Secretary-General of the Kurdistan Islamic Union, and a former member of the Iraqi Governing Council.

Yılmaz_Güney.title: Yılmaz Güney
Yılmaz_Güney.extract: Yılmaz Güney was a Kurdish film director, screenwriter, novelist, actor and communist political activist. He quickly rose to prominence in the Turkish film industry. Many of his works were made from a far-left perspective and devoted to the plight of working-class people in Turkey. Güney won the Pal

Said_Nursi.title: Said Nursi
Said_Nursi.extract: Said Nursi, known also as Said-i Kurdî, was a Kurdish scholar of Islam from Turkey who wrote the Risale-i Nur Collection, a body of Qur'anic commentary exceeding six thousand pages. His focus was on a revival of personal Islamic faith "through study, self-reform and service of others".

Celadet_Bedir_Khan.title: Celadet Alî Bedirxan
Celadet_Bedir_Khan.extract: Celadet Alî Bedirxan, also known as Mîr Celadet, was a Kurdish diplomat, writer, linguist, journalist, political activist and nobleman. He held a master's degree in law from Istanbul University, completed his studies in Munich, and spoke several languages including Arabic, Kurdish, Russian, German,
